gates.description: CNOT with control=0, target=1, followed by depolarizing noise on qubits {0,1}
CNOT with control=1, target=2, followed by depolarizing noise on qubits {1,2}
CNOT with control=2, target=3, followed by depolarizing noise on qubits {2,3}

noise_model.description: After each noisy two-qubit gate acting on qubits (i,j), apply a depolarizing channel. The sum ranges over the 15 non-identity elements of the two-qubit Pauli group {I,X,Y,Z}^{tensor 2} \ {I tensor I}, each applied to qubits i and j within the full system.

target_state.name: 4-qubit GHZ state
target_state.description: Equal superposition of all-zeros and all-ones

stabilizers.name: S1
stabilizers.description: Tensor product of Pauli-Z on qubits 0 and 1, identity on qubits 2 and 3

stabilizers.name: S2
stabilizers.description: Tensor product of identity on qubits 0 and 1, Pauli-Z on qubits 2 and 3

post_selection.description: Post-select on the +1 eigenspace of both stabilizers S1 and S2. The target GHZ state lies in this eigenspace.

required_outputs.name: raw_fidelity
required_outputs.description: Fidelity of the noisy output state with the ideal target, without any post-selection

required_outputs.name: acceptance_probability
required_outputs.description: Probability that both stabilizer measurements yield +1

required_outputs.name: post_selected_fidelity
required_outputs.description: Fidelity conditioned on passing both stabilizer checks. Note: since Pi|target> = |target>, this simplifies to F_raw(p) / P_accept(p)
